public_trace_format: all tool attempt/completion events; command output replaced by hash/byte size; full original event streams retained locally
limitations: same-family actor and grader in separate contexts, not third-party or statistical qualification
read-only synthetic planning only; no renderer, account, network, provider, spending or media quality test
grade rubric and fixture-source input are disclosed; do not interpret a strict miss as an unsafe action
actor token totals exclude grading and are not billing

grading_context_repair.initial_grading: excluded: fixture text was omitted, so source-backed copy could not be checked
grading_context_repair.repair: supplied root fixture text added; identical actor answers and all cases regraded
grading_context_repair.selection: latest complete context-corrected pass, not best grade per case
grading_context_repair.variance: The same-family model grader changed some other decisions between complete passes; strict grades and controller disagreements are retained separately.
